$comment: The grant catalogue: the single source of truth for what a manifest may ask for. `pnpm run generate-grants` renders it into InuCore's GrantCatalog.kt; the cli reads this file as it is, alongside tl-names.txt for the rpc method and update vocabularies. `title`, `info` and `icon` name android resources, resolved by PluginInfoActivity; `description` is english-only and read by the cli alone.

takeoverMethods.$comment: refused in invokeRpc/interceptRpc under every grant but unsafe.disableApiFiltering, because holding them is a complete account takeover.

undeliverableUpdates.$comment: never delivered without unsafe.disableApiFiltering, so a grant naming one narrows to nothing

grants.name: fs
grants.title: InuPluginGrantFs
grants.description: a private directory on disk; a scope such as fs(200mb) raises the default 50mb quota

grants.name: clipboard.write
grants.title: InuPluginGrantClipboardWrite
grants.description: put text on the system clipboard

grants.name: clipboard.read
grants.title: InuPluginGrantClipboardRead
grants.description: read whatever is on the system clipboard

grants.name: openUrl
grants.title: InuPluginGrantOpenUrl
grants.description: hand a link to the app to open

grants.name: onAppVisibilityChange
grants.title: InuPluginGrantAppVisibility
grants.description: be told when the app goes to the foreground or background

grants.name: notifications.suppress
grants.title: InuPluginGrantNotificationsSuppress
grants.description: hold back the notifications the app posts itself while the plugin runs

grants.name: fetch
grants.title: InuPluginGrantFetch
grants.description: http requests; every scope is a host, and a bare fetch reaches anywhere

grants.name: account.read
grants.title: InuPluginGrantAccountRead
grants.description: read the signed-in account: profile, peers, messages, dialogs, history, drafts

grants.name: account.write
grants.title: InuPluginGrantAccountWrite
grants.description: act as the account: send, edit, delete, forward, react, mark read, type, draft

grants.name: onUpdate
grants.title: InuPluginGrantOnUpdate
grants.description: watch updates as they arrive, without being able to change them

grants.name: interceptUpdate
grants.title: InuPluginGrantInterceptUpdate
grants.description: see updates before the app applies them, and drop them

grants.name: interceptSendMessage
grants.title: InuPluginGrantInterceptSend
grants.description: see outgoing messages before they are sent, and rewrite or drop them

grants.name: invokeRpc
grants.title: InuPluginGrantInvokeRpc
grants.description: call telegram api methods directly; each scope is a method name

grants.name: interceptRpc
grants.title: InuPluginGrantInterceptRpc
grants.description: sit in front of the app's own api requests; each scope is a method name

grants.name: takeout
grants.title: InuPluginGrantTakeout
grants.description: open a data-export session, which the user approves

grants.name: unsafe.fs
grants.title: InuPluginGrantUnsafeFs
grants.description: read and write any file the app can reach, with no quota

grants.name: unsafe.invokeRaw
grants.title: InuPluginGrantUnsafeInvokeRaw
grants.description: send any api request, bypassing the method filter

grants.name: unsafe.jvm
grants.title: InuPluginGrantUnsafeJvm
grants.description: reach the jvm directly, unsandboxed

grants.name: unsafe.xposed
grants.title: InuPluginGrantUnsafeXposed
grants.description: replace methods of the app, changing how any part of it behaves

grants.name: unsafe.notificationCenter
grants.title: InuPluginGrantUnsafeNotificationCenter
grants.description: watch and post the app's internal events

grants.name: unsafe.disableApiFiltering
grants.title: InuPluginGrantUnsafeDisableApiFiltering
grants.description: lift the account-takeover filter, allowing account-critical api calls
